name: Brog's PDF Editor
description: 100% client-side PDF editor docked to the browser's side panel: merge, reorder, insert, redact, annotate, fill or add form fields (with AI autofill from a local profile, another document, or a saved template), watermark, number pages, edit metadata, extract or compress images, split, OCR/make scanned pages searchable, and summarize with Chrome's on-device AI. No files ever leave your browser.
